title: The dispatcher routes multiple cron expressions to distinct handlers by expression match
asA: developer whose Worker needs to schedule two or more distinct workloads on distinct cron cadences
iWant: one dispatcher module that accepts an ordered map of {expression, handler} pairs and, on every scheduled invocation, routes to the matched handler with a bounded context {expression, scheduledTime, sink}
soThat: one wrangler.toml [triggers] crons block with multiple cron expressions maps cleanly to distinct handler code paths without hand-rolled conditionals

acceptanceCriteria.description: createDispatcher({routes, sink, skewToleranceMs, softBudgetMs, clock?}) returns a dispatch(event) function. Calling dispatch({cron, scheduledTime}) invokes exactly the handler whose expression string-equals the cron field, passes {expression, scheduledTime, sink} to it, and returns without invoking any other route's handler.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a dispatcher wired with two routes and two spy handlers
acceptanceCriteria.when: dispatch is called with a specific expression matching one route
acceptanceCriteria.then: only the matched spy handler is invoked exactly once with the bounded context

acceptanceCriteria.description: Calling dispatch({cron: expressionNotInRoutes, scheduledTime}) does NOT invoke any handler, fires a cronUnmatched event on the sink with metadata {event, expression, scheduledTime, outcome: unmatched, duration: 0} and returns without side effect.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a dispatcher wired with two routes and two spy handlers
acceptanceCriteria.when: dispatch is called with an expression not in the routes
acceptanceCriteria.then: no spy is called, a cronUnmatched event fires, and dispatch returns without side effect

acceptanceCriteria.description: Single-handler mode: createDispatcher({routes:[{expression:"*/5 * * * *", handler}], mode:"single-handler", sink, ...}) invokes the single handler on EVERY dispatch regardless of the incoming event.cron value. A dispatch({cron:"1 2 3 4 5", scheduledTime}) still invokes the single handler with bounded context {expression:"1 2 3 4 5", scheduledTime, sink}; no cronUnmatched event fires because unmatched has no meaning in single-handler mode.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a dispatcher with mode:"single-handler" and exactly one route
acceptanceCriteria.when: dispatch is called with an expression different from the routed one
acceptanceCriteria.then: the single handler is invoked with the incoming expression as bounded context; no cronUnmatched event fires

acceptanceCriteria.description: Malformed event: dispatch({cron:null, scheduledTime}) or dispatch({}) does NOT invoke any handler, fires a cronMalformed event on the sink with metadata {event:"cronMalformed", expression:null, scheduledTime, outcome:"malformed", duration:0} and returns without side effect.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a dispatcher wired with two routes
acceptanceCriteria.when: dispatch is called with a missing or null cron field
acceptanceCriteria.then: no handler is invoked, a cronMalformed event fires on the sink, and dispatch returns without side effect

acceptanceCriteria.description: Duplicate expressions refuse: createDispatcher({routes:[{expression:"* * * * *", handler:h1}, {expression:"* * * * *", handler:h2}], ...}) throws a named error kind CRON_DISPATCHER_DUPLICATE_EXPRESSION at construction time, naming the duplicated expression string. No route is registered.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a call to createDispatcher with two routes carrying the same expression
acceptanceCriteria.then: the factory throws CRON_DISPATCHER_DUPLICATE_EXPRESSION naming the duplicated expression

acceptanceCriteria.description: Empty routes refuse: createDispatcher({routes:[], sink, ...}) throws a named error kind CRON_DISPATCHER_EMPTY_ROUTES at construction time; no dispatch function is returned.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a call to createDispatcher with an empty routes array
